foldseek.name: Foldseek
foldseek.command:
foldseek search \
    human-38fdd87d_fsdb/db zebrafish_fsdb/db result foldseek_tmp \
    --threads 16 \
    -e 10.0 \
    --max-seqs 1000

hhblits.name: HH-suite (hhsearch)
hhblits.command:
ffindex_apply \
    human-38fdd87d_hhdb/db_a3m.ffdata human-38fdd87d_hhdb/db_a3m.ffindex \
    -d results.ffdata -i results.ffindex \
    -- hhsearch -i stdin -d zebrafish_hhdb/db -blasttab /dev/stdout -cpu 16 -v 0

mmseqs2_iterative.name: MMseqs2, three rounds
mmseqs2_iterative.command:
mmseqs search \
    human-38fdd87d_mmdb/db zebrafish_mmdb/db result mmseqs_tmp \
    --threads 16 \
    -s 7 \
    --num-iterations 3 \
    --max-seqs 1000 \
    -e 10.0

mmseqs2_seqseq.name: MMseqs2
mmseqs2_seqseq.command:
mmseqs search \
    human-38fdd87d_mmdb/db zebrafish_mmdb/db result mmseqs_tmp \
    --threads 16 \
    -s 7 \
    --max-seqs 1000 \
    -e 10.0

prostt5.name: ProstT5 + Foldseek
prostt5.command:
foldseek createdb filtered.fasta zebrafish_prostt5/db \
    --prostt5-model weights --gpu 1 --threads 8

foldseek search \
    human-38fdd87d_prostt5/db zebrafish_prostt5/db result tmp \
    --threads 16 \
    -e 10.0 \
    --max-seqs 1000
